title: Printing machine made by Mergenthaler Linotype Co used to print Bombala Times
lineage: Museum catalogue and interpretive history; it describes a particular machine and local newspaper.

passages.note: The collection dates use of a particular Model 8 at the Bombala Times to 1940–1985 and says the Johnson family owned the newspaper in 1938–1975; it does not establish whether the machine was purchased or leased.
